YOUR NEXT SESSION

Where to focus

How priorities work

For each topic, we pool marks from its latest three recorded assessments. Topics below your subject goal (or 80% until you set one) come first, ranked by the percentage-point gap. Stronger topics stay on a maintenance list. More than 14 days without a result adds a review reminder, not an assumed decline. Recommendations are rules, not predictions.
